scientific_integrity: Main earlier \(q>2\) result and classical Paley inequality explicitly credited. Every \(q>1\) implication is proved with a new compact compression lemma; no independent audit or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Equality of Hilbert–Schmidt composition-symbol classes only for normalized weights supported exceptionally on a Hadamard lacunary sequence, not a universal norm-comparison theorem for \(q\le2\) or a classification of all Schatten ideals.
title: Hilbert–Schmidt composition classes for every Hadamard lacunarity ratio
